name: collection_log
description: Collection log: account-wide obtained/total counts, plus the tab/page/item catalog. Unfiltered the catalog is ~1,900 items and a very large response, so FILTER IT: page to get one boss's log, or search to find a specific drop. IMPORTANT - per-item obtained state only exists for pages the player has opened in game this session, because the game only sends it for the visible page; everywhere else an item simply has no obtained field, which means unknown, NOT missing. The uniqueObtained/uniqueTotal counters are always accurate and are the right source for 'how complete is my log'.

page.description: Only pages whose name contains this text, case-insensitive (e.g. 'Vorkath'). The usual way to keep the response small.

search.description: Only items whose name contains this text, case-insensitive. Pages left with no matching item are omitted.

obtained.description: true for obtained items only, false for missing ones only. Only matches items on pages viewed in game this session, since elsewhere the state is unknown.

capturedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant, UTC. Transported as a JSON string; no native date-time type is implied.

uniqueObtained.description: Account-wide unique items obtained, read from the game's own counter — always accurate, unlike per-item state.

capture.description: How much per-item detail this session has managed to observe.

catalog.description: Tab name to pages. Tabs are Bosses, Raids, Clues, Minigames, Other.

additionalProperties.description: Page name (e.g. "Abyssal Sire") to its contents.

itemCount.description: Total items on this page, ignoring any filter.

viewedThisSession.description: Present only when the player opened this page this session; without it, items carry no obtained state.

obtainedInViewedPage.description: Items obtained on this page, valid only when viewedThisSession is true.

obtained.description: Present only for pages viewed this session. Absent means unknown, not missing.

qty.description: Quantity obtained; present only when obtained is true and non-zero.

itemsReturned.description: How many items the items array actually holds. Present only when a filter dropped some.

filter.description: Echo of the filter applied. Absent when the response is unfiltered.
